name: Daring Knight
text: Whenever one of your cards loses rank, gain +15 nil value.

signature.trigger: a card in your hand loses rank

archetypes: Nil Champion; splash Discard Dominance, Nil Guard
decision: Whether to spend rank-lowering effects (Waning Moon, Pauper's Disguise, Thrown Towel, Spare Moustache) on a hand you might bid nil, since each lowered card makes the nil both safer and richer.
opponent: Each trigger is shown. Opponents who lower your cards add to your nil value too.
aiNote: Treat each lowered card as +15 toward a nil bid; prefer lowering your highest cards.
rationale: It pays for the archetype's signature move, lowering your own high cards, instead of punishing it. A Nil Champion seat lowers two to four cards a round (Waning Moon alone lowers two), so a nil gains +30 to +60 nil value, about +15 EV at a 50% nil rate and 75% success. Nil value pays only on a successful nil, so lowering cards in contract rounds pays nothing.
deviation: Redesigned from +15 nil value per face card or ace held when bidding nil, which punished a deck built to remove its high cards.
